yaml:
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Rollout
metadata:
  name: vllm-serving
  namespace: vllm-serving
spec:
  replicas: 1
  revisionHistoryLimit: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: vllm-serving
  strategy:
    blueGreen:
      activeService: vllm-active
      autoPromotionEnabled: false
      previewService: vllm-preview
      scaleDownDelaySeconds: 30
  template:
    metadata:
      annotations:
        spike-revision: HEADROOM-COLDSTART-03-RETRY
      labels:
        app: vllm-serving
    spec:
      containers:
      - args:
        - --model=Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct
        - --port=8000
        - --gpu-memory-utilization=0.3
        - --enforce-eager
        - --max-model-len=2048
        image: vllm-cpu-env:latest
        imagePullPolicy: Never
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /health
            port: 8000
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 11
        name: vllm
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8000
          name: http
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /health
            port: 8000
          periodSeconds: 5
          timeoutSeconds: 11
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: "3"
            memory: 6Gi
          requests:
            cpu: "2"
            memory: 4Gi
        startupProbe:
          exec:
            command:
            - python3
            - /opt/probes/warmup_probe.py
          failureThreshold: 90
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 65
        volumeMounts:
        - mountPath: /dev/shm
          name: dshm
        - mountPath: /root/.cache/huggingface
          name: hf-cache
        - mountPath: /opt/probes
          name: warmup-probe
          readOnly: true
      volumes:
      - emptyDir:
          medium: Memory
          sizeLimit: 1Gi
        name: dshm
      - hostPath:
          path: /home/ubuntu/hf-cache
          type: DirectoryOrCreate
        name: hf-cache
      - configMap:
          name: vllm-warmup-probe
        name: warmup-probe
